title: The Twelve Tribes
subtitle: Sons of Jacob, blessings and allotments
sources: All from the text: births (Gen 29:31–30:24; 35:16–18), Jacob's blessing (Gen 49), Moses' blessing (Deut 33), allotments (Josh 13–19; Levi's cities, Josh 21). Map label positions are approximate centers of each allotment, authored for this app; tribal borders shifted over time and several are uncertain.

tribes.name: Reuben
tribes.note: Firstborn; settled east of the Jordan.

tribes.name: Simeon
tribes.note: Inheritance within Judah's territory; absent from Moses' blessing.

tribes.name: Levi
tribes.note: The priestly tribe: no territory, but 48 cities among the others. "The LORD is their inheritance" (Deut 18:2).

tribes.name: Judah
tribes.note: The scepter shall not depart from Judah — the royal line of David and of Christ.

tribes.name: Dan
tribes.note: Later migrated north to Laish, renamed Dan (Judg 18).

tribes.name: Joseph: Ephraim
tribes.note: Joseph's sons were adopted by Jacob as tribes (Gen 48:5); Ephraim led the northern kingdom.

tribes.name: Joseph: Manasseh
tribes.note: Half the tribe settled east of the Jordan (Josh 13:29–31).

tribes.name: Benjamin
tribes.note: Rachel died giving birth. Saul and Paul were Benjamites.
